definitions.explanation: The act or process of removing or neutralizing unpleasant odors. Commonly used in relation to household products, cleaning, and hygiene.

examples.japanese: {消臭|しょうしゅう}⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{消臭|しょうしゅう}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This detergent has a deodorizing effect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{消臭|しょうしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重曹|じゅうそう}→重曹：14496_juusou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that baking soda is effective for deodorizing refrigerators.

notes:
Composed of {消|しょう} (eliminate) and {臭|しゅう} (odor, smell). Very common in everyday life, especially in product labeling and advertising.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {消臭|しょうしゅう}⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧: deodorizing spray
- {消臭|しょうしゅう}{剤|ざい}: deodorizer
- {消臭|しょうしゅう}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: deodorizing effect
- {消臭|しょうしゅう}{力|りょく}: deodorizing power
- {消臭|しょうしゅう}・⟦{除菌|じょきん}→除菌：07789_jokin⟧: deodorizing and sanitizing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脱臭|だっしゅう}→脱臭：20917_dasshuu⟧: deodorization — more technical, often used for industrial processes
- {消臭|しょうしゅう}: deodorizing — everyday term, common in consumer products
- ⟦{芳香|ほうこう}→芳香：13960_houkou⟧: fragrance — adding a pleasant smell rather than removing a bad one

USAGE:
{消臭|しょうしゅう} products are ubiquitous in Japan. The homophone ⟦{召集|しょうしゅう}→召集：11951_shoushuu⟧ means "summons" or "convocation" — completely different meaning.
